messages:
jordan: Quick Q — I need a tight path to surface a customer's latency slice (TTFT p50/p95/p99) + tokens/sec for the last 30m. Where do folks look first?

maria: Grafana -> 'Latency Overview' dashboard is the fastest. Panels: 42 (TTFT p50/p95/p99 by route), 57 (tokens/sec). Quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/latency-overview?orgId=1

sam: For PromQL reference, we usually use histogram_quantile for pxx. Example we surface in panels: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
```
That gives p95 per route/model.

maria: Also good to slice by customer tag: add `customer_id` label on the panel or query, e.g. add `by (customer_id, route)` and then use dashboard variable to filter.

jordan: Perfect — where do I grab a trace for a sample slow request? Need one to attach to the ticket.

maria: Jaeger -> service=runtime, filter `route="/v1/generate"` and `tags.customer_id=customer-X`, sort by duration desc. Quick trace search link: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=runtime&tags=customer-X&minDuration=200ms

sam: For alerts/proposals: current global p95 alert is 500ms for 15m. For this paying customer I suggest an override: p95 > 800ms for 15m (alert only for their slice). Also add tokens/sec drop alert: tokens_per_sec < 120 for 5m.

lee: I can add an alert override in our alert rules config (alert-rules/overrides/customer-overrides.yaml). Will open a PR and include the panel links + promql.

maria: When you create the PR pls include the exact queries and the grafana panel ids. Also ping @eng-oncall and @eng-sre for signoff on thresholds.

jordan: Thanks — small checklist for PR description: 1) customer id, 2) alert rules (yaml) snippet, 3) grafana links, 4) runbook link.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: alert-rules/customer-overrides.yaml -> staging (build 5942) :gear:

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/7123 — includes p95 override + tokens/sec alert + grafana panel links. CC @maria @sam

sam: I'll review tomorrow morning and run the queries against a 30m window.

jordan: Awesome, thanks everyone. Saved links to the runbook under the customer ticket. :thumbsup:
